recognize_zh: 一顆比小淋巴球大的淋巴球，細胞核圓至略腎形偏向一側、染色質成塊，最明顯的是豐富的淡藍色細胞質中散佈數顆粗大的紅紫色嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules），這就是大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）。
features: Medium-to-large lymphocyte, about 1.5–2 times an RBC
Low N:C ratio with abundant pale blue cytoplasm
Round to slightly indented eccentric nucleus with coarse, clumped chromatin; no nucleoli
Several coarse azurophilic (red-purple) granules clustered in the cytoplasm
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single large granular lymphocyte. The cell has a round to slightly indented nucleus with clumped chromatin and no nucleoli, surrounded by abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing a few coarse azurophilic granules. Background red cells and platelets are unremarkable. Findings represent large granular lymphocyte morphology, which corresponds to cytotoxic T cells or NK cells; a persistent absolute increase would warrant flow cytometry and TCR clonality studies.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have deeply basophilic cytoplasm that hugs adjacent RBCs and usually lack discrete azurophilic granules.
Monocytes are larger with folded nuclei, lacy chromatin and gray-blue cytoplasm with fine dust-like granules and vacuoles.
Hairy cells have circumferential fine cytoplasmic projections, oval nuclei with finer chromatin and no azurophilic granules.
